keyword.en: diesel mixer pump vs diesel 40 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 柴油搅拌泵和柴油40的区别

title.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40有何不同

description.en: Diesel 40 is a pump-only row at 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h. The diesel mixer prints 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h and a mixer series note.
description.zh: 柴油40是只泵送的一行：4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h。柴油搅拌泵印 4108 / 66–75 kW、25 m³/h，并有搅拌机系列说明。

h1.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40有何不同

directAnswer.en: The diesel mixer and Diesel 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai that both mention a 4108 engine. Diesel 40 prints 66 kW, 26 m³/h and one distance pair, 120 m / 360 m, with no mixer motor. The diesel mixer prints 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, three stone-distance rows and the note 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. The mixer is not a pump-only trailer.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的机器，都提到 4108 发动机。柴油40印 66 kW、26 m³/h 和一组距离 120 m / 360 m，没有搅拌电机。柴油搅拌泵印 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、三行石子距离，以及说明：30 型配 400 搅拌机，40/50 型配 500 搅拌机。搅拌泵不是只泵送的拖泵。

heading.en: Where Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump and Diesel 40 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 25 m³/h; Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 23 MPa; Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Dimensions: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Main unit weight: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4200 kg; Diesel 40 prints 2800 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油搅拌泵一体机印 25 m³/h；柴油40印 26 m³/h。最大出口压力：柴油搅拌泵一体机印 23 MPa；柴油40印 25 MPa。外形尺寸：柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm；柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。整机重量：柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4200 kg；柴油40印 2800 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints cells that Diesel 40 does not: Diesel engine 4108 / 66–75 kW; Stone capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m; Series note 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Diesel 40 prints cells that Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump does not: Diesel engine power 4108 / 66 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机有、柴油40没有的行：柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m；系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。柴油40有、柴油搅拌泵一体机没有的行：柴油机功率 4108 / 66 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Seeing 4108 on both pages does not remove the mixer series note from one of them. Open /en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/ for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump and /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 两页都出现 4108，并不能取消其中一页的搅拌机系列说明。看柴油搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/，看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump print the same theoretical output as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 25 m³/h. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油搅拌泵一体机印 25 m³/h。柴油40印 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump print the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 23 MPa. Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油搅拌泵一体机印 23 MPa。柴油40印 25 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump print the same dimensions as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is diesel engine missing on Diesel 40?
question.zh: 为什么柴油40没有柴油机？

answer.en: The Diesel 40 page does not print that label. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4108 / 66–75 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油40这一页没有印这个标题。柴油搅拌泵一体机印的是 4108 / 66–75 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
